description.narrative: Project Outcomes | Stakeholder Effect Increased access to finance for SMEs including WSMEs and agri-SMEs. Contribution to Market Creation | Competitiveness The Project intends to demonstrate the effectiveness of the enhanced risk management practice through risk mitigation mechanism, in expanding and exerting competitive pressure in the lending markets.

The proposed IFC investment is an unfunded Risk Sharing Facility (RSF or the Project) with Dashen Bank S.C. (Dashen or the Bank), a FIG portfolio client in Ethiopia since May 2022, for up to eight years, under which IFC will guarantee up to US$10 million equivalent in local currency (LCY)covering 50% of the Banks credit riskon a target portfolio of loans to small and medium enterprises (SMEs) with a maximum portfolio amount of US$20 million equivalent in LCY. The RSF will include (i) a 20% target to Agri MSME loans, and (ii) a 25% target for women-owned/led small, and medium enterprises (WSMEs). The Project would be processed under IFCs Small Loans Guarantee Program (SLGP), a programmatic approach to de-risk and scale-up financing for MSMEs in eligible countries, such as Ethiopia.
